column1: # Supported agents — the table IS the support. Adding one is a row plus a test, never a branch.
# `id` follows the UPSTREAM's spelling wherever the upstream has one, so the two never disagree
# about what a thing is called: the ids below were read out of the case statement in
# `instruction` is the file that agent reads at the start of a session. Every value here was
# read from that same script — except where marked OURS in the comment below, and that
# distinction matters: the first version of this table claimed all four came from upstream and
# two did not (independent review of cycle 057).
# `commands` is where slash-command definitions go: `-` means WE HAVE NOT VERIFIED the format
# for that agent, so nothing is installed there. Shipping files nobody reads is not support.
# `harness` says whether the agent runs Claude Code hooks. For everyone else the layer is not
# installed, and the installer says why.
